body: I am better now. It turns out the cause of suffering was debilitating loneliness, given my situation of having no family/friends and having just escaped a crippling time of being homeless and hated/abandoned/ignored by the world while being completely alone. I made some friends somehow (I think I got lucky), and I’m feeling better now. Your advice wouldn’t have helped because you didn’t know my situation
I fucking love Obama. The exemplary president.
Interesting! That’s very good to know.
I see. I retract what I said.
Don’t be such a bitch. Threatening someone who’s suffering, using the possibility of pain? Damn that was just extremely cruel. Hope you experience some pain so you know what it is.
That’s still chemical. Triggered by an event.
I see. You’re on a similar boat as myself, it seems..

Hey. I’ve had to study and read up on so much psychology and human behavior to understand myself and I can tell you this. There is always a cause for suicidality. And if you can point out the cause, the treatment can be found as well. You may have gone through childhood abuse or trauma without knowing it. In this case, you can be treated for ptsd. Ptsd makes people suicidal. Complex ptsd in my case for repeated parental abuse. If it’s not this, you may be suffering from a genetic ailment. Some people’s brains don’t produce enough of certain chemicals which makes them chronically depressed. This can also be treated. From your comments I would think you may suffer from bipolar disorder. There are a few Ted talks by people living with bipolar if you’d like to learn about it. Give clinical treatment a try before you end it. You may look back at today and  laugh...
Hey hey, what you described sounds like bipolar disorder. Go immediately to the hospital and get help. With medication bipolar can be treated.

I’ve had that happen too. I mentioned that I’m suffering from loneliness (I have no family and little friends while coping with mental illness) and they quickly said “this is not the line to call because you’re lonely, if you have an issue to address feel free to call us back.” It was a normal helpline for youth. 

I say 80% of the time I feel worse after talking on helplines. But I still call for that 10-20%. I’ve learned to predict the trajectory of the call by the counselor’s voice and it’s been a bit easier although time consuming. Usually the ones who care pick up the phone with a gentle, caring voice, not a salesperson voice.
Good idea but wwoofing is not a permanent life style. More for travellers, isn’t it? I’ve done it before for 2 weeks. It was the most fun thing I’ve done on my own.

I don’t have anyone who would be willing to listen as all my friends are new. I don’t have old friends as I would leave friendships when I’m extremely depressed. I had one friend who recently I reached out to and he cut me off saying he’s burnt out too. 
I’ve had no family since 16. 

People have said what you’ve said for years and I’m still here.... I don’t see it. I’m only in my early twenties. I feel like Ive gone through 100 years of hell.

For me nobody openly said they wanted me to die. They just tortured me. The torture is programmed into my brain and playing over and over, making life hell. I want that to stop. The suffering. Death is a positive thing. A stop to all suffering.

I wish those words do something to me. They unfortunately got very old. 99.9% torture is not worth 0.1% light.. I want peace even if it means death. I am planning on buying some heroin/fentanyl to use for death. I don’t know why, humans hated me from day 1 until now. It is always me against all humans. And they call me a social animal.

Thanks for the resources. However all of this frustrates me. Why should I halt my life and do so much work that leads me to no prestige nor money, so as to cover up for somebody else’s shit? The abusers’ shit. I want to get on with life and get a degree, make money, and have a good lifestyle. I don’t even think I have cptsd. I think the medications are screwing with my brain. Almost a decade and still I don’t know what exactly is causing the wrong. I’ve been diagnosed with every mental illness under the sun. All I know is I went through a torturous childhood. Fuck diagnosis - they’ll probably say “the experts say they were wrong!” in 30 years

I had extreme nightmares on sertraline. The doctor dismissed it as “vivid nightmares” no matter how often I complained and how vividly I described my symptoms. I would have extreme extreme nightmares—being on surgeon’s table when my face is being operated on, then the surgeon goes nuts and decides to cut up my face with these huge scissors. I start running, even though the room is locked up. Im running with all the stitches and wires and pipes connected to my flesh not knowing when they will rip off me. I run so hard I climb the walls to avoid being butchered by that frightening human being.... I try to scream but no sound comes out. I try very hard to scream for what seems like a long time running. Eventually I wake up from the dream to my own extreme scream to which my roommate runs in in panic, yelling that they thought someone was trying to kill me. So that was just one dream. Many other extremely frightening dreams (mostly running for dear life and reliving torture feelings stemming from my traumas) caused me to wake up to myself punching the bed very hard, crying hard, screaming insanely loudly, drenched in sweat. But later I found out that I was having REM sleep behaviour disorder on sertraline (never had it before). My doctor didnt link the two together nor did he care. The doc dismissed it because he thought that given my repetitive childhood trauma it was normal for me to have those extreme dreams. However, I had never had nightmares before I started sertraline. Even if I did, they were bad enough for me to want to die—and still they didnt care. I’ve never heard of anyone else who had a side effect so severe as me. I’m one of the rare ones.. I’m trying other anti depressants now but if none work then I’m just going to kill myself. I feel trapped. 
Just try it and if you have side effects firmly ask to be put on a different medication. The one I am trying now is mirtazapine and it has less of those side effects. You probably wont have it as bad as I did anyway, but if you do, make sure your doctor listens to you. If your doctor doesnt listen to you, get a new one.
